title: knockout-type — the photograph shows only through the letters
idea: The headline is cut out of a solid panel and the photograph shows through the letterforms only. There is no picture on the page — the type is the picture, and the band stays a flat colour field everywhere else.
why_new: every image today is a rectangle behind, beside or under the type. Nothing puts the image inside the letterforms.
built_from: one heading carrying a reviewed knockout class, one image bound to it as the fill; a solid root surface. No cover block.
risk: needs a legibility floor — short words, heavy weight, and a busy photograph destroys it. Wants a reviewed fallback to solid colour when the image is low contrast.
